statement: During preparation and execution the comparative campaign never obtains an image, a harness commit or a reference-client package from the network on its own initiative and never substitutes another source or outcome when one is missing: an absent image is a typed image_unavailable refusal naming host, role and image, with --pull=never on every campaign docker run; an absent harness commit is a typed load_generator_commit_absent refusal before any worktree exists; the reference client installs offline only and a missing tarball is a typed offline_cache_incomplete refusal naming it; a host whose thermal decision cannot be read stays excluded and the exclusion carries a typed reason. Placement of images, the harness commit and the reference-client cache is an explicit provisioning step that exists in code for every supported target (the home lab and GCP), so no target that worked before is left with only a refusal.

constraints.statement: Owner rule: no legacy or fallback logic anywhere; unavailability is an explicit typed outcome (R11). Decisions recorded 2026-11-14: missing image refused, --pull=never everywhere, provisioning explicit and separate; reference client offline only; lab image provenance is the loaded image's content digest.

A refusal replaces a fallback only together with the explicit provisioning that makes the supported path work: the GCP provisioning script places images by digest, seeds the reference-client package cache and places the harness commit; a statement in code or prose that provisioning does something must be true at the same commit.

Selection, deployment, workload, deadlines, admission and evidence behaviour are otherwise unchanged; journey and benchmark predicates and bounds are untouched. This quest does not claim a campaign ran.
Independent verification on the exact candidate before landing; tests run on lab hosts through the local controller; a failed run stays recorded as failed.
